channel.title: Hashicorp incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Hashicorp's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Errors creating new VCS workspaces with Bitbucket cloud provider [resolved]
item.description: Our Engineering team has resolved the issue with creating new VCS workspaces with the Bitbucket cloud provider. If you continue to experience any problems, please open a ticket with our support team.

item.title: Delayed HCP Terraform Runs [resolved]
item.description: Our Engineering team has resolved the issue. These systems should now be operating normally. If you continue to experience any problems, please open a ticket with our support team.

item.title: Terraform AWS Provider v6.59.0 — errors during plan for aws_network_acl_rule resources [resolved]
item.description: Our Engineering team has resolved the issue. We released the Terraform AWS Provider v6.60.0 with a fix. Affected systems should now be operating normally. If you continue to experience any problems, please open a ticket with our support team.

item.title: Issues When Downloading Terraform Providers [resolved]
item.description: 3rd party provider downloads are confirmed to be functioning. Please retry any failed Terraform runs, and contact support if you have any further problems.

item.title: DR Cluster Creation Failures [resolved]
item.description: We have implemented a mitigation for the issue affecting new Disaster Recovery (DR) cluster creation. Initial validation has been successful, and new DR cluster creation is functioning as expected. We are continuing to monitor the service to ensure stability before considering the incident fully resolved.
